input.js: String? authored or URL webJs fallback; null differs from empty for delay

input.cacheFirst: Bool original cache preference, not permission to fabricate cache parity

response.body: String including empty, equal accepted JVM policy body
response.redirected: Bool actual navigation redirect observation, never URL inequality alone on supported OS
response.originURL: String? original request URL, required exact when redirected

generalWebPolicy.authority: Native-only independent runtime operation; trusted typed Host closure. Never forward this operation or policy.* method/function from WK script message/prompt. Same JVM/session/page/source and parent bounded deadline.
generalWebPolicy.reply: Existing WebJS reply envelope kind=string,value:String? or void; no new payload store
generalWebPolicy.configure: params:[registeredSource Bool string]. ACK string configured; once before any bridge/eval. Host derives actual current indexed BookSource with matching tag; rule+nonemptyHTML installs cache always, source/java only registered=true. Source invalidation still revokes entire lease.
generalWebPolicy.evaluate: params:[raw Android-equivalent JSON result String?]. kind=string,value=JSON{retry:Bool,delayMs?:Int,body?:String}. null/empty/literalnull raw retries; JSON-quoted empty/null are accepted; JVM Apache StringEscapeUtils.unescapeJson then ^quote|quote$ stripping preserves original semantics. delays200,400,600,800,1000 then1000; retry>30 fails typed WEBJS_TIMEOUT.
generalWebPolicy.navigation: params:[actual navigation request URL]. kind=string,value=true/false String via java.util.regex.Pattern.matcher.matches. A match records accepted terminal body=requestURL, responseURL=initial request URL, no synthetic redirect.
generalWebPolicy.resource: params:[actual resource-load URL] same Java full-match. Current public WK host must refuse unsupported complete HTTP(S) resource interception before pretending this ran; no performance/DOM inventory substitution.
generalWebPolicy.cookie: params:[actual observed page URL, actual WK Cookie header String?]. kind=void. JVM calls existing platform.cookie.setCookie(original cookieTag,rawNullable); nullable tag means no mutation. Same original app-owner mode remains authoritative; read-only cannot gain writes. Snapshot/seed uses existing native CookieStore; no new cookie store.

webJsRequest.authority: WK-exposed finite java/cache/source functions only on admitted rule nonemptyHTML interfaces; explicitly reject method policy.* and request.function policy.*. Login JS2 behavior unchanged.
webJsRequest.existingMethods: Existing finite request(run/ajaxAwait/connectAwait/getStringAwait), java.* and cache.* remain under actual cache/java interface admission. Unknown/unported original methods typed unsupported.

operations.webJsPageClose: Existing same-session seal/cancel/native-cancel/actual-drain/close; general producer always awaits result then closes in finally.

routing.javaWebView: RuleJsExtensions.webView3/4 returns platform general StrResponse.body; plus original webViewGetSource and webViewGetOverrideUrl4/5/6 overloads. Non-login original task authority, no login browser admission flag.
routing.analyzeRule: New requester-aware overload of existing RulePlatform.webJs preserving old test override ABI; source headers/tag + content.toString + GSON result +cacheFirsttrue +10s +isRuletrue. General getInjectionString, NOT JS2.
routing.analyzeUrl: Retain option useWebView/webJs/webViewDelayTime. Only use browser when option.useWebView && call.useWebView. POST once through same AnalyzeUrl/JVM HTTP, forced original postForm/postJson selection, no XML/bodyJs transform before WebView; followRedirectsfalse &300..399 returns original raw response without Host. Otherwise pass final response URL/body, initial headerMap. GET/nonPOST loads actual URL. js option wins jsStr only when nonnull.
routing.response: Synthetic200/OK/HTTP1.1/emptyheaders; HTML redirect adds actual prior302 Found with originalURL. POST redirect protection preserves original raw headers/status. General accepts actual JS empty String, unlike login await nonempty-body rule.

lifetime.allExecutors: Existing Preview, actual ContentBatch and BookCallback each attach same Runtime/session/task/source and existing grant before producer execute; all finish/cancel/error drains page and same Host work before close(session)/revoke. No source service gate reacquisition.
lifetime.page: Extend existing RuntimeSession.originalPages with general policy state and same mutex/child task routing. Basic pages get no native java/cache/source; rule interfaces require final nonemptyHTML, cache always, java/source actual registered tag only. No parent live Rhino Context borrowed.
lifetime.deadline: General60s or rule10s capped existing parent deadline; existing native task/runner enforces actual browser deadline. JVM validates page deadline on policy/bridge and final publication; no new VM/executor or blocking on single deadline scheduler.
lifetime.effects: MayStart/Started/EvaluateIssued/CookieIssued etc are distinct bounded facts before native issue; actual accepted state/cookie facts retained on child and still-active parent. Fail/cancel never fake rollback or rewrite completed parent receipts.

platformLimits: Full Android onLoadResource parity for HTTP(S) cannot be implemented by public WKNavigationDelegate or HTTPS WKURLSchemeHandler. sourceRegex packets must receive explicit unsupported until a genuinely equivalent existing public hook exists; backend Java matching remains exact for future real resource callbacks.
WK default trust remains intact. Android Backstage SSL error proceed policy is not copied as an insecure downgrade; actual platform SSL failure stays failure, not empty success.

cacheFirst uses existing WK cache policy but Android cache database/network/image scheduling equivalence is not proved. blockNetworkImage must use an actual public WK blocking mechanism or remain explicitly unsupported; CSS hide is not equivalent.
No general WebJS/flight/full BaseSource API completeness claim. Necessary rule source finite methods are explicit; all remaining file/crypto/download/extra source functions remain typed unsupported.
